Container.Name: cast-to-roon
Container.Overview: Captures the line-out of a Google Cast / AirPlay receiver (e.g. Arylic LP10) from the host's Line In and serves it as a lossless FLAC Icecast stream that Roon can play as an internet radio station. Set SOURCE_MODE to "tone" to test the Roon side before the capture hardware is wired up.

Config.Name: WebUI / stream port
Config.Description: Icecast port. The stream is http://[IP]:[PORT]/cast.flac

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds test audio and optional icecast.xml overrides

Config.Name: Source mode
Config.Description: alsa = capture Line In, tone = 440 Hz test signal, file = loop TEST_FILE

Config.Name: ALSA device
Config.Description: Capture device. Find it with 'arecord -l' inside the container.

Config.Name: Icecast source password
Config.Description: Change this. Allowed characters: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -

Config.Name: Station name
Config.Description: Shown by Roon and on the Icecast status page

Config.Name: Mixer init
Config.Description: Semicolon-separated amixer commands run at startup, e.g. sset 'Input Source' Line;sset 'Capture' 60% cap

Config.Name: Enable MP3 mount
Config.Description: Serve an MP3 320k fallback at /cast.mp3 alongside the FLAC mount
